meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在重构代码时会先弄清你的意图,扫描整个代码库,评估测试覆盖,制定详细计划,再分步修改并每步运行测试验证,最后做完整回归检查,确保不破坏现有功能。
howto.when: 当你提到 refactor、cleanup、restructure 等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会先分析该文件再动手。

say.text: 把 AuthService 类里的验证逻辑提取到独立模块
say.note: Claude 会先找依赖再重构。

say.text: 清理所有使用废弃 API 的代码
say.note: Claude 会评估影响范围后逐步清理。

howto.what_en: After install, when refactoring, Claude clarifies intent, maps the codebase, checks test coverage, plans, applies changes stepwise with tests, and runs a final regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like refactor, cleanup, restructure, etc.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze the file before changing it.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into a separate module
say_en.note: It maps dependencies first, then refactors.

say_en.text: Clean up all code using deprecated APIs
say_en.note: It assesses impact before making changes.
